title: For the 58th Time: Maccabi Tel Aviv Are Champions of Israel
description: Maccabi Tel Aviv are champions of Israel for the 58th time in their history. Oded Katash's side beat Hapoel Tel Aviv 83-79 on Tuesday night in a thrilling Game 4 of the Winner League playoff final, completing a 3-1 series win to lift the championship plate once again. Having earlier won the State Cup, the Yellows sealed their first domestic double since 2020/21, capping a challenging campaign in the sweetest fashion.
